title.en: Charter Day of the City of Naga
title.orig: An Act Declaring September 5 of Every Year a Special Working Public Holiday in the City of Naga Province of Cebu to be Known as the "Charter Day of the City of Naga"

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2013/ra_10357_2013.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: September 5 of every year is hereby declared to be a special working public holiday in the City of Naga, Province of Cebu to commemorate its founding day and to be known as the "Charter Day of the City of Naga".
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
